tools.name: list_my_estates

tools.name: complete_onboarding
tools.description: Set up a new estate for the signed-in user and generate their personalized probate checklist. Use this when list_my_estates returns no estates (or one with no deceased details yet), or the user is just getting started. tools.name: lookup_county_guide
tools.description: Look up SwiftProbate's published probate guide for a specific US county: verified courthouse address/phone/website, filing fee, approved newspapers for publication, e-filing system, and county-specific probate forms. Use this before answering any question about a county court's contact info, filing

tools.name: lookup_institution_guide
tools.description: Look up SwiftProbate's estate-notification guide for a financial institution (banks, brokerages, life insurers, credit unions, and more): estate department phone/hours/fax, mailing and overnight addresses, online notification URL, required-document checklist, and which account types require probate.

tools.name: find_probate_forms
tools.description: Find the probate forms for a jurisdiction: each form's name, code, description, official court source link (when known), and SwiftProbate page, plus whether it is a county-specific or statewide form. Some states (e.g. Florida) publish no statewide fill-in forms — pass the county to get the usable co

tools.name: get_state_overview
tools.description: Get high-level probate facts for a US state: small-estate threshold, filing deadline, creditor-claim period, estimated timeline, court filing fee, average attorney fee, whether it is a UPC / community-property / independent-administration state, plus a prose overview and the SwiftProbate guide URL.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search SwiftProbate's probate reference data (US states, counties, financial institutions, and court forms). Returns a list of results, each with an id you can pass to `fetch` for the full record. Use it for open-ended probate reference questions before answering from model knowledge.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full SwiftProbate reference record for an id returned by `search` (a state overview, county court guide, institution notification guide, or a jurisdiction's forms).

tools.name: get_estate_summary
tools.description: Get a summary of the estate including details, assets, heirs, and task statistics. Use this when the user asks about the estate overview or general status.

tools.name: get_tasks
tools.description: List tasks with optional filters. Use this to find tasks by status, category, asset, or search term. tools.name: get_task_detail
tools.description: Get full details of a specific task by ID, including its description, status, priority, deadline, notes, and linked documents.

tools.name: get_assets
tools.description: List every asset in the estate with its type and value. Your Estate Context already lists the assets, so call this only when you need the full set fresh (e.g. right after creating or updating one) or the context block was truncated. For one asset's linked tasks, use get_asset_detail instead.

tools.name: get_asset_detail
tools.description: Get one asset's full details plus the tasks linked to it, by asset ID. Call this when the user asks about a specific asset's tasks or you need details beyond what the Assets context block shows. Get the asset_id from that context block.

tools.name: get_heirs
tools.description: List every recorded heir with relationship and details. The Heirs context block already lists them, so call this only to refresh after adding or updating an heir, or when that block was truncated.

To read a document's contents, use read_document instead.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "estate" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_state_overview, fetch, mark_assets_complete, update_estate · Private data: lookup_county_guide, lookup_institution_guide, search, fetch, get_task_detail, get_documents, get_activity_log, mark_assets_complete, log_transaction, create_heir, mark_heirs_complete, update_estate · Public sink: complete_onboarding, find_probate_forms, get_documents, mark_assets_complete · Destructive: edit_task, update_asset, update_estate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_state_overview, fetch, mark_assets_complete, update_estate · Private data: lookup_county_guide, lookup_institution_guide, search, fetch, get_task_detail, get_documents, get_activity_log, mark_assets_complete, log_transaction, create_heir, mark_heirs_complete, update_estate · Public sink: complete_onboarding, find_probate_forms, get_documents, mark_assets_complete · Destructive: edit_task, update_asset, update_estate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
